title: The Fog Sea
hook: It's in the fog. It's bending down.
question: Would you hide in the fog, or run for it?
synopsis: The Hush is right behind the last car on the high moor. Ahead, the valley is full of white fog. Rook puts out every light and takes the dark train down under the fog.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The moor lamps went out. It's here!
Look! The valley is full of fog!
Lights out, fire low. Into the fog!
It sees only fog. Slow and quiet.
The fog is rising... over its face!
Out of the fog! Lights on! Full steam!
Keep the fire hot! It's coming!
Mist Town! Lights ahead. Hold on!
Safe for now. It will be back.
